comment: ANCHOR: SELF_HEAL_RUNBOOK_COVERAGE_20261108 — the self-heal replay corpus (LQ-1238) is exercised through the
LQ-1231 engine the way the fixer calls it: plan_runbook(failure_class, evidence, contract, now) with the
fixture's receipt as evidence, a synthetic lane contract and a FIXED clock, so a plan does not change with the
hour. 22/22 fixtures must resolve to a definite plan in the catalog, with a whitelisted action, the lane echoed
and a byte-identical repeat; the printed table records each fixture's corpus expectation beside the engine's
answer. Signatures the catalog cannot classify yet are pinned as a CEILING (CATALOG_GAPS_20261108): a new
unclassified signature fails. Synthetic fixtures only; no DB, no network, no live coordination store.
